entries.title: AMD External Events Utility
entries.explanation: AMD advisory PA-365 acknowledges possible excessive SSD writes at idle on Radeon RX 7000 and RX 9000 products. As checked on November 12, 2026, a resolution is under development; the advisory names no fixed version. A matching process name does not establish that these writes have this cause. A quiet sample does not rule out the issue at another time.

fixes.title: Check AMD's advisory and official release notes
fixes.steps: Adrenalin 26.11.1 is an unconfirmed reported target, not a verified fix. The version target comes from the secondary reports linked below. Before considering a compatible driver update, check AMD's advisory and official release notes for explicit confirmation of this issue's resolution. Record the current package and a supported rollback route, then compare passive samples after an owner-approved update.

fixes.title: Investigate sustained writes before considering a workaround
fixes.steps: Compare timed process I/O deltas across stable process identities and corroborate file destinations and drive host writes before assigning a cause. Process I/O is not NAND wear. If the symptom is reproduced, a temporary service A/B test can be considered with owner approval and display/hotkey checks. Record the exact service startup and running state first and restore both afterward. PA-365 does not prescribe disabling this service. Sentinel never changes services itself.

entries.check: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='atieclxx.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId, CreationDate, WriteTransferCount
